description: Election Commission - E. M. A. K. Ekanayaka was selected as the member of the Hingurakgoda P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Hingurakgoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters, specifically categorized as Elections Gazettes.
